title: Bounty Notice — Ferrik Redthane
location: General Access Terminal — Blacksand Downport / Lower City Public Kiosk
date: CURRENT CYCLE — FILED BY PLANETARY AUTHORITY, TORPOL
author: Planetary Authority, Torpol — Filed via independent relay
content:
NOTICE OF BOUNTY — ACTIVE

Subject: FERRIK REDTHANE
Alias(es): Unknown
Last Known Association: Darokyn's Retinue (FORMER — EXPELLED OR FLED)
Last Known Vessel: Misery's Company (current status: damaged, location: Borite system, unconfirmed)

Charges Filed By: Planetary Authority, Torpol and Clarke
Charges: Coordinated assault on civilian shipping lanes, attack on surface installations, suspected piracy conspiracy.

Bounty Amount: On file with issuing authority. Contact required for exact sum.
Bounty Condition: Alive preferred. Dead accepted if evidence of involvement in attacks is presented.

—

Note: Additional interest in this individual has been registered by at least one private party. We do not know who. We are not required to share. The private interest predates the official bounty by several weeks.

Note: Redthane has not been sighted on Theev in several months. He is believed to be hiding off-world. His associate, Miria Silverhand, has been active in Blacksand City as of this cycle, apparently negotiating on his behalf.

Note: Admiral Darokyn has made it known — quietly — that he does not consider Redthane under his protection. This is significant.

Capture or confirmed termination should be reported to the filing authority through an appropriate intermediary. We do not recommend walking into an Imperial office to collect.

title: Darokyn Personnel File — Redthane, F.
location: General Access Terminal — Grand Hotel, Upper City (Administrative Partition)
author: Darokyn Retinue — Internal Personnel Office
content:
PERSONNEL FILE — FERRIK REDTHANE
Status: EXPELLED. Record retained for operational reference.

Years of service: 4
Role: Raiding coordinator, light fleet operations
Performance: Above average. Tactical initiative strong. Discipline: inconsistent.

Cause of expulsion: CLASSIFIED — ACCESS RESTRICTED TO FLAG STAFF

— Summary note (unclassified portion):
Redthane departed the retinue following an incident that the Admiral has chosen not to detail in the formal record. The departure was not mutual. Redthane was informed that his continued presence on Theev would be unwelcome.

He was not told this gently.

— Operational note:
Redthane retained contacts from his time with the retinue. He has used these to operate independently. The attacks on Torpol and Clarke were planned and coordinated in a manner consistent with his training. This is noted without any implication that the retinue sanctioned or supported those operations.

The retinue did not sanction or support those operations.

— Final note:
If anyone asks Admiral Darokyn directly why Redthane was expelled, the Admiral will not answer the question. He will change the subject with remarkable skill. We recommend not pressing the point in the Admiral's presence.

We recommend pressing it elsewhere.

roll_check.on_success: Darokyn internal file accessed. Redthane's expulsion reason is sealed. The Admiral is hiding something.
roll_check.on_failure: Partition locked. Retinue administrative files require elevated clearance.

title: Miria Silverhand — Known Associates File
author: Widow Administrative Office — Intelligence Division
content:
KNOWN ASSOCIATES FILE — MIRIA SILVERHAND

Subject: MIRIA SILVERHAND
Also Known As: N/A
Cybernetic: Right arm, full replacement. Strength-rated. Integrated weapon linkage suspected.
Current Location: Blacksand City, lower city. The Scrapheap, upper deck of a downed Fat Trader. Bridge compartment.

Background summary: Former Imperial merchant crew. Captured by pirates. Rose through piracy by demonstrated ruthlessness. Now a senior lieutenant and operative for Ferrik Redthane.

Current activity: Negotiating independently on Redthane's behalf. Has approached both Vallis and Irontooth gangs. Seeking protection and alliance. Using the Scrapheap as a base. Running messages via local boys — does not expose herself unnecessarily.

Threat assessment: HIGH. Armed with a gauss pistol and a rapid-fire machinegun. The machinegun is resting on the captain's chair in her current position, aimed down the main corridor. The corridor doors are rusted open. She has a clear field of fire the length of the deck.

Note: She has a self-destruct device integrated into her cybernetic arm. This is confirmed intelligence. It is a frag-equivalent device. It has a one-round countdown. If she activates it, you have approximately two seconds to do something about the situation.

— Approach with extreme caution. Do not underestimate the arm.

roll_check.on_success: Widow intelligence file accessed. Miria's exact position, armament, and self-destruct confirmed.
roll_check.on_failure: Intelligence partition locked. File not accessible at this clearance level.

title: Darokyn Files — Classified Partition Extraction
location: General Access Terminal — Grand Hotel, Upper City (Administrative Partition)
author: Darokyn Retinue — Internal Personnel Office (Sealed Partition)
content:
The Darokyn personnel file for Ferrik Redthane contains a sealed partition marked CLASSIFIED — ACCESS RESTRICTED TO FLAG STAFF.

The unclassified portion states only that Redthane 'departed following an incident that the Admiral has chosen not to detail.' The classified portion contains the actual incident record.

Breaking the partition requires stripping a non-standard encryption layer the retinue uses for sensitive personnel actions.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> PARTITION DETECTED: CLASSIFIED — FLAG STAFF ONLY
>> ESTIMATED CONTENT: INCIDENT RECORD — FULL ACCOUNT

steps.reject_message: COMMAND NOT RECOGNISED. PARTITION REMAINS LOCKED.

lines: >> LOCATION: BORITE SYSTEM — OUTER BELT — DERELICT VESSEL
>> REDTHANE WAS FIRST ABOARD. HE FOUND SOMETHING.
>> THREE CREW DIED IN THE SUBSEQUENT INCIDENT.
>> TWO OF DAROKYN'S OFFICERS WITNESSED THE FIND.
>> BOTH HAVE REFUSED TO DESCRIBE WHAT THEY SAW.
>> THE FIND ITSELF IS NOT DESCRIBED IN ANY FILE.
>> THE FIND IS WHY REDTHANE CHANGED HIS PRIORITIES.

on_complete.message: The classified record is sparse — whoever wrote it was careful. But the shape is clear: Redthane boarded a derelict in Borite's outer belt and found something that changed what he was willing to do. Three people died. Two witnesses won't speak. Darokyn buried it rather than put it on record in a court-martial. Whatever Redthane found on that derelict is the reason for everything that followed — the Torpol and Clarke attacks, the falling out, the bounty. The question is what it was.

on_failure.message: PARTITION STRIP FAILED. Retinue encryption layer held. Access attempt has been logged against this terminal's session ID. If the Admiral reviews the log, he will know someone tried.

title: Krrsh — Statement (Informal, Post-Rescue)
location: General Access Terminal — Blacksand Downport (Filed by arriving crew)
author: Krrsh, Captain — Misery's Company (former)
content:
I'm filing this because whoever saved me from that station deserves to know what they're walking into.

Ferrik Redthane planned the Torpol and Clarke attacks. He coordinated at least three ships, maybe more. Misery's Company was involved — I won't pretend otherwise — but Ferrik was running the operation. It was his plan. His targets. His call.

I mutinied because the attack on Clarke went further than what was agreed. He hit civilians. That wasn't the job. That was something else.

After the mutiny my crew put me on the station with whatever was living there and jumped for Borite. Ferrik doesn't know I'm alive. As far as he knows I'm dead in a derelict somewhere.

He's hiding. He needs Miria to broker a deal with one of the big gangs so he can come back to Theev without getting killed by Darokyn. That's the only reason Miria is here.

Find Miria, you find Ferrik.

The codes I gave you will get you through the Skull. After that, Blacksand is its own problem. Don't walk alone in the lower city. Don't trust anyone who smiles first. And if a woman with a metal arm offers you a deal, she has a machinegun under the table.

I mean that literally.

Good luck. You earned the codes. Make them worth something.

title: Contractor Debrief Addendum — Parallel Crew Observation
author: Analyst 7C
content:
Subject focus remains Ferrik Redthane network remnants, but a secondary note is filed for two independent pirate-adjacent crews operating in overlapping blocks tonight.

Crew A shows disciplined comms silence and top-city social access. Crew B shows lower-city procurement behavior, high cash burn, and consistent use of third-party couriers. Neither group appears aware the other is being tracked under the same case umbrella.

[[redacted diff=11 skill="Investigate" attempts=2]]
Temporary recommendation: allow both crews to pursue Bay 7-C lead until one surfaces the quartermaster. Intercept only after identity confirmation to avoid burning surveillance assets.[[/redacted]]
